database_engine: PGlite PostgreSQL with mocked Supabase auth/storage and mocked manager-PIN crypt for refund tests; pgcrypto extension omitted

Admin appearance publishes to the same business; staff appearance stays private
No promotion returns regular price
Active fixed promotion and request price agree
Percentage and expired/scheduled promotions
Invalid discounts and date windows rejected
Selection snapshots active promotion and aggregate stock protects shared variants
Claim then checkout records promotion receipt and actual conversion
Stale and missing quoted price rejected without stock deduction
Media primary/label, cross-shop objects and malformed media
Token view validation, session dedup and administrator analytics
Employees cannot manage promotions/media or read analytics
Cross-shop mutations and invalid token payloads rejected
Unavailable customer product and inactive option blocked at payment
Storage policies allow own admin folder and deny cross-shop/employee upload
Catalogue metadata and standalone payload expose only customer fields
Proper variants have unique prices identities and immutable inventory mode
Shared variant price receipt cost and master stock deduction
Independent variant lot stock deducts once without touching master stock
Variant FEFO excludes expired lots and preserves stock on failure
Fixed bundle allocates exact price and deducts every component once
Category-choice combos validate choices and reject a foreign shop product
Kitchen workflow friendly order numbers and ready-display privacy
Pre-order quote deposit and final payment are idempotent and linked
Custom cake quote private reference and cash deposits balance correctly
Explainable forecast and approved scheduling do not deduct inventory
Shortage alerts refresh resolve/dismiss and retain audit events
Independent-variant refunds restore only its own lots and stock
Bundle refund value equals allocated sale price and restores all components
Independent variant approved production transfers output once
Scheduled production plans are linked and duplicate approval is rejected
Variant disable preserves receipt history and blocks new selection
Staff catalogue works when customer display is disabled; cart repricing is authoritative
Every new table has RLS and API roles cannot write ledgers or invoke private helpers
Recipe-scaled variant production consumes usable ingredients once and propagates expiry/cost
POS quote and checkout agree for a loyalty reward on allocated bundle pricing
Customer profile history links scheduled orders and sales; large order numbers do not truncate
Source-batch recalls and held-lot refunds/disposal cannot reintroduce unavailable variant stock
Commercial mutations and private checkout helper enforce staff/admin boundaries
RC1 temporary-password staff cannot bypass setup through RLS or RPCs
RC1 checkout retry returns one receipt and deducts stock and cash once
RC1 reused checkout references reject changed amounts and foreign staff
RC1 insufficient cash rolls back sale, inventory, tender and retry ledger together
RC1 checkout ledger is isolated and cannot be written directly by API roles
RC1 supporting FEFO, allocation, kitchen, pickup and checkout indexes exist
RC1 physical stock counts reject a concurrent sale and preserve the lot ledger
Bakery UAT receives supplier lots and converts whole eggs with traceable yields
Bakery UAT recipe production, variance and waste keep stock and ingredient lots aligned
Bakery UAT catalogue, variant promotion, kitchen, POS receipt and daily cash agree
Bakery UAT reports, refund, portable backup, audit and immutable day close reconcile
Original and cropped photos persist separately without exposing uploader metadata
Gallery rejects foreign originals and preserves existing saved photos on failure
Customer request settings enforce administrator, allowed methods and canonical HTTPS origin
Anonymous pre-order submission needs no pickup, uses server promo prices and never reserves stock
Public request input rejects disabled methods, malformed contact, stale prices and foreign products
Request RLS prevents public reads/direct writes and foreign-shop staff access
Only selected contact action is permitted to staff; alternate method needs admin reason and audits once
Request states reject stale/skipped transitions and schedule exactly one linked order
Linked request follows real production/paid collection, with one stock deduction
Register opening is admin-only, station-stamped, audited and immutable for the day
Disabled/rotated customer links stop requests and receipt sharing
Four workspace roles preserve base administrator authorization and password setup lock
Universal search is bounded and excludes foreign records, costs and forbidden entity types
Per-user preferences validate languages and remain private across staff and shops
Role dashboards and board stage writes are scoped, optimistic and never change stock
Kitchen and inventory direct API calls cannot read or mutate customer service records
Customer tracking capability exposes safe status only and preserves idempotent intake
Staff notes and contact templates are separate, scoped and never automatically sent
Customer confirmation uses the exact pipeline without creating payment, pickup or stock changes
Retired product purchasing routes cannot receive made-in-house stock; history stays readable
UX backup includes preferences, role assignments and staff notes without tracking capabilities
Low-stock cards need no alert refresh, and blocked/issue notifications keep stable role-scoped IDs
Administrator financial dashboard totals use the business day and all sales; other roles receive no financial amounts
Public catalogue branding follows only its enabled token shop and neutral logo fallback
Direct acceptance from new request uses current variant quote, optional pickup and atomic real deposit
Accepted receipt uses immutable accepted prices, real deposits and excludes internal notes
Accepted orders reach kitchen, dashboard and planner once without duplicate jobs or stock deduction
Direct decline is reasoned, audited once and available from legacy review states
Acceptance, quote, receipt and decline enforce four roles, shop isolation and public denial
Direct acceptance retains allocated bundle prices through quote, receipt and one stock deduction
Recent staff activity is bounded, deterministic, administrator-only and excludes event details
Kitchen includes manual pre-orders and cakes once with safe item projection and no customer PII
New shop, supplier and customer phones use international canonical storage and reject malformed input
Anonymous request normalization precedes replay checks and rate limits; contact override remains audited and normalized
Purchasing identification and original photos are tenant-private and audited
Preferred and substitute barcodes match; mismatches require reasoned authorized override
Supplier offers retain normalized unit cost and immutable comparison history
Configured approval blocks direct ordering and conversion is idempotent
Receiving cannot bypass configured verification through legacy PO or stock RPCs
Verified receiving preserves lot accounting, partial quantities and exact retry idempotency
Inventory purchasing projections show operational records without historical costs
Failed receiving checklist rolls back stock and override audit without approval
Production reservations are idempotent commitments; accepted-order demand is replaced once by linked batches
Latest approved normalized supplier cost drives full recipe cost and target margin without exposing costs to production
Projected stock subtracts forecast and reservation once and rounds suggestions to supplier packs
Existing FEFO consumption releases reservations on completion, records waste once and traces supplier lot into sale
Operational role projections hide costs, reject cross-tenant recall and return stable exception IDs
Workspace ownership is established atomically at bootstrap; employees cannot claim it
Workspace privileged lifecycle RPCs are denied to authenticated browser roles
Workspace exports are shop-scoped and remove PINs/passwords/tokens recursively
Deletion refuses missing/stale backup, wrong name and missing confirmations; owner can cancel
Restore creates a new workspace, never replaces an existing ID or membership
Restore rejects foreign rows, credentials, unsupported tables and foreign public references atomically
Full supported table snapshot roundtrips through UUID remapping into an isolated workspace
Permission presets protect owner and admin grants, support manager/accounting, and audit old/new customization
Import validates every row and rejects duplicates, malformed values, phones and foreign inventory without partial writes
Imported opening stock uses ledgers; exact retries replay once and changed retries reject atomically
Setup progress and enriched search remain tenant-scoped, permission-aware and bounded
Full operational snapshot restores recipes, cash/stock ledgers, lots and reservations without replaying business side effects
Expired recovery can be permanently purged only for its confirmed owner and leaves no partial tenant data

limitations: Live Supabase deployment, real bcrypt PIN checks, storage HTTP upload, Edge Functions and browser UAT still require target-environment verification.
